run_xnli_encode: run the LASER XNLI encoding pipeline to tokenize, apply BPE, and encode premise and hypothesis files for all 15 languages
run_encode_load: run EncodeLoad to initialize a LASER sentence encoder from a checkpoint file with optional CPU mode and batch settings
run_token: run Token to tokenize multilingual text files with optional romanization, lowercasing, and gzip compression
run_bpefastapply: run BPEfastApply to apply Byte Pair Encoding subword tokenization to pre-tokenized text files using BPE codes
run_encodefile: run EncodeFile to encode BPE-tokenized text into LASER sentence embeddings and save them to a binary file
